companyDescription: AAV gene therapy developer · RGX-121/NAVSUNLI for MPS II now on FDA clinical hold with no near-term resubmission expected — but RGX-202 (Duchenne) already met its Phase III primary endpoint and BLA submission is guided for this quarter, plus a partnered retina program (ABBV-RGX-314) with positive 3-year durability data
priceNote: Live $7.69 on Nov 11, 2026. The prior report (Oct 26) used $6.85, a +12.3% drift. Q3 was reported Nov 5 (not Nov 9 as the prior report had it).
summary: Refresh: the Q3 print (Nov 5; the prior report wrongly dated it Nov 9) narrowed the loss on a Sarepta settlement gain ($39M cash in Oct) and left $251M cash at Sep 30. The real binary is unchanged: ABBV-RGX-314 (surabgene lomparvovec) ATMOSPHERE + ASCENT pivotal wet-AMD toplines, which management says come "this quarter" (Q4 2026), with no exact date. Negatives since the last report: RGX-121 is on FDA clinical hold (Aug), and the RGX-202 DMD BLA slipped to a single Q1 2027 submission. The stock is +12% since Oct 26. Core Base bias +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a multi-week horizon, not a 14-day call.

catalysts.name: ATMOSPHERE + ASCENT pivotal topline — wet AMD
catalysts.description: Management guides "this quarter" (Q4 2026), followed by global filings in 2027. Partnered with AbbVie.

risks: RGX-202 BLA submission (guided Q3 2026) not confirmed in the sources checked — a slip would hurt credibility.
RGX-121 clinical hold (spinal imaging findings) — possible read-through concerns for intrathecal AAV programs.
ABBV-RGX-314 pivotal is a genuine binary with an AbbVie split of economics.
Net loss ~$196M (2025) — further financing likely (a 424B5 was filed in 2026).

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Sub-$500M gene-therapy name; small-cap biotech risk appetite drives the multiple.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a 25bp December hike is priced after the hot CPI. The tails are a 50bp move or a hot Nov 25 PCE, both of which hit small caps first, so the dip entry is preferred.
